tips: | [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Try baiting Ahri's W before engaging in basic attack trades as it provides a lot of upfront burst in the early game. Note that you prefer extended trades so even if you get bursted you should keep fighting since Ahri has high spell cooldowns. | Positioning around minions is very important so as to not get caught out by a charm, though try to keep enough of a distance to not get chipped by her Q.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Do your best to chip down Akali with basic attacks and Bouncing Bombs throughout the early lane phase, as she can't respond too well besides with her Q. | Be on guard against her E constantly, and remember that you can cancel it with a well-timed Satchel placed under yourself.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health, and start Doran's Ring.] | Avoid trading with Akshan at all costs, and just try to get through lane without dying. Be very careful if you don't see Akshan on the map as getting jumped from stealth can be a death sentence for continued laning. Remember that the length of Akshan's boomerang is extended through minions, and that Akshan's ultimate can be blocked by minions, towers, and allied champions.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Try to maintain distance as a few Anivia Q + E combos can screw over your whole laning phase and Anivia can re-cast her Q to detonate early, making it hard to dodge close up. Avoid using your Satchel until after Anivia creates a wall, if possible.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Since Annie has relatively low range for her spells, try to poke her down from a position where she can't reach you. Try to be very respectful of her while she has access to her stun, as you don't really have much counterplay against a Flash Ignite combo, especially after Level 6.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Bully Aurelion Sol as much as possible during laning phase. Try standing behind minions so you don't get affected by the additional burst damage from his breath. As he can't move while using his breath, he becomes very vulnerable to Bouncing Bombs during it. Use your Satchel to disrupt Aurelion Sol's flight.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Avoid standing next to minions so the Azir player has to decide between using soldiers to poke you down or to clear the wave. Maintain your distance after Level 6 to avoid dying to his shurima shuffle combo as your Satchel is far too ineffective of a dash.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Try to poke her down a bit Level 1, and do your best to dodge her poisons from Level 2 onward, as they make her immediately win trades. Buy boots early if you must. Keep in mind that Satchel can't be used as a dash while grounded by Miasma.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Play very safely and do not engage in trades Level 1 as Corki with Hail of Blades and his gatling gun will halve your healthbar in seconds due to the armor reduction. Try to abuse the 12 second windows between Hail of Blades and his gatling gun to poke him down. Use your Satchel to disengage from him dashing onto you and applying his gatling gun.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Do your best to chip down Diana with basic attacks and Bouncing Bombs while avoiding her Q. Without getting marked, a Diana is heavily discouraged from jumping on you, and even if she does, you can easily disengage with Satchel Charge.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | An Ekko with Hail of Blades is impossible to trade against early game, especially since his dash Level 1 will make him easily stick to you. Keep your distance and only try beating him down with basic attacks and abilities while his E is on cooldown (9 seconds) in the early game. Use your Satchel immediately once you see his stun light up, or when he hits you with his dash attack.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | An Ekko with Electrocute is much more manageable, especially since he's more likely to start with Q, making his Level 1 much weaker and letting you play more aggressively. Apply the advice mentioned above.

I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.]
You should be able to constantly harass him in the early game as using Playful Trickster leaves him vulnerable for 16-8 seconds each time.
You can cancel Fizz's dash through you with your Satchel.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Modern Galio builds are pretty burst damage heavy and his tankiness mostly stems from runes instead of itemisation, meaning you should be able to poke him down during laning quite easily. Keep some distance while his dash is available (11 second cooldown) and poke him as much as you can, as the Magic Shield only renews itself after not taking damage for 12-8 seconds. Do your best to use Satchel to disengage as soon as possible when he dashes towards you, as the duration of his Taunt depends on how long he is able to charge it.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Gangplank's early game is pretty miserable until he purchases Sheen, so you should be able to play the early game quite aggressively and aim for minion denial and kills. Once he gets Sheen you have to become a lot more respectful of his barrels as they start dealing a significant amount of damage. Keep in mind that Gangplank's barrels become noticeably stronger at Levels 7 and 13!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Garen is nigh impossible to bully in lane due to his innate sustain, so just try to farm up gold from him using First Strike. Try using Satchel more sparingly so you can comfortably disengage from Garen after Level 6 onward to avoid getting executed by his ultimate.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Gragas can be pretty difficult to kill due to his passive healing and W's damage reduction, but he's still quite manageable. Try to dance around minions to make it difficult for him to stun you, and respect his burst combos if he has Flash, Ignite and/or Electrocute!

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Hwei is pretty abusable during laning phase, as you have typically greater range than him and better poke. Keep in mind that you can position yourself around minions to avoid his fireball, fear, and root abilities, and that his pull requires him to get close to you, giving you an easier time to hit abilities on him.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health, and start Doran's Ring.] | Irelia is really difficult to play against, especially when she manages to stack up her passive, so position yourself away from minions that have low health and be very careful of her stun. Keep in mind that her ultimate passively reduces the cooldown of her dash, making it very difficult to face her one-on-one later!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Jayce's early can be pretty unassuming and easy for you to bully, but his burst damage can be pretty scary after a few recalls. Be sure to stand behind minions as often as you can to avoid being hit by his cannon bolts. Keep in mind that you can cancel his hammer leap with your Satchel Charge, or dodge it with Flash in a pinch!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with the Precision path, and start Amplifying Tome.] | K'Sante is one of the best neutralisers to pick against a Ziggs, due to his innate tankiness, sustain and powerful trades. Try to get as much gold from him as you can using First Strike, avoid fighting him in close quarters or by walls (due to his ultimate) and just prioritise farming.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Karma can be quite annoying due to her strong early game and sustain, but it's not too bad in the early game. Do your best to stand behind minions to avoid getting hit by Karma's Q, especially her ultimate-empowered one. Be careful not to get too close either, as her root can heal her more based on her missing health if empowered, though you can create distance with your Satchel Charge.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Karthus is pretty easy to bully in lane due to his immobility, so do your best to beat him down with attacks and abilities. Keep in mind that Karthus Q does less damage if it hits multiple targets, so stay next to minions if possible! I'd recommend buying Verdant Barrier at some point in the game to negate this ult.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Kassadin in lane is very easy to bully and threaten kills off of, but he can get pretty scary from 2 items onward. Try to zone him off of minions with basic attacks and abilities in the early Levels if possible, and start playing a bit more safely from Level 6 onward as his gapclosing potential becomes a lot more powerful.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Katarina is pretty easy to abuse in the early game but her extended trades, especially with Conqueror, can be pretty scary. Avoid standing next to her daggers and keep trades short with just 1 Q and sometimes a basic attack. Save your Satchel so you can cancel her ultimate during fights!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health, and start Doran's Ring.] | LeBlanc is really tough because her short trades and mobility are unmatched here. Avoid getting too aggressive from Level 2 onwards as her Q + W combo hits like a truck, but do try to use the windows of opportunity where she doesn't have her dash (15-10 seconds in the early game) to wear her down a bit with your abilities and try to accrue as much gold with First Strike as you can.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Lissandra's abilities have very long cooldowns relative to yours, so play aggressively whenever Lissandra uses her ice shard or dash. Avoid standing behind minions, as Lissandra's ice shard explodes upon contact with a unit, making its hitbox and range bigger. If Lissandra dashes on you and roots you, try to Satchel to disengage as fast as possible.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Lux has really strong trades, but it's still possible to gain the upper hand because your Q cooldown is significantly lower than her root and E, letting you be mildly more aggressive. Make sure to play around minions often, as her root only works on the first 2 targets hit, but staying too close to minions lets her get off high value E's that manage to hit both the wave and you.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with the Precision path, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Malphite is pretty hard to poke out due to his passive, Doran's Shield and Second Wind. Try to get as much gold from him as you can using First Strike, and try to maintain dominance over the wave so he's unable to roam with his ultimate.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Malzahar is pretty abusable due to his low range and immobility in the early game, and you should chip at his health with Qs. Keep your distance from infected minions so the infection cannot spread to you.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Morgana is just a farmfest but you have stronger waveclear than her and you can bully her quite effectively. Keep in mind that standing behind minions can block her root.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Naafiri is a pretty weak assassin against Ziggs but a few effective Qs from her can be scary, so it's best to keep your distance somewhat. You can have an easier time hitting your own Qs if you target her pets. Hold your Satchel for when she uses her dash, as you are able to immediately cancel it, by placing it under yourself, if you hit her with it while she's flying towards you

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | You really need to keep your distance from Neeko. Keep counting the amount of minions per wave so as to not get caught off guard and position yourself in a way so that there aren't any minions between you and Neeko, as her root becomes more powerful after hitting a target first. First Strike is non-viable as a Neeko disguised as a minion counters it entirely.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | You should be able to bully Orianna with empowered basic attacks and abilities quite effectively during the early game. Avoid taking extended trades as Orianna's own passive gets stronger the more she attacks and position yourself on the opposite side of the lane to where her ball is placed, so that it's easier to react to if she's trying to play aggressively.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health and start Doran's Ring.] | Pantheon is pretty easy to bully but his burst can be pretty dangerous, especially if they take Ignite. Keep in mind that you can cancel his stun with a Satchel placed under yourself, so if their movement becomes a lot more simplistic (as if they pressed W, targeting you), prepare your own W to counter it.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Qiyana is extremely weak in her first few Levels, and her Level 1 is borderline unplayable, so you should do your best to bully her with attacks and abilities as much as you can at that point. Play a bit more carefully after Level 3 as her burst becomes much more respectable, but poke her down during the windows in which she doesn't have her E (11 seconds). Be careful not to play near walls so as to not get caught out by a Qiyana ult!

| [Midlane] [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Rakan is very easy to bully in lane, especially due to his basic attack range being significantly lower than yours. He relies entirely on his burst in the early Levels, and the cooldown on his knock-up is quite hefty (16 - 10 seconds), so use those windows to constantly harass him with basic attacks and abilities. You should stand behind minions from Level 2 onwards, as his healing ability can get blocked by them.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Ryze will have better extended trades than you, so don't fight for longer than 1 Q and maybe a passive-empowered basic attack. Don't stand too close to minions as flux can spread from minions to you, letting his Q incidentally hit you. In case Ryze is trying to use his ultimate to escape, remember that a well-timed Satchel Charge can prevent him from teleporting!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Singed is pretty non-threatening until Level 6, but will get impossible to deal with as he gets items. Bully him in lane as hard as you can to prevent him from getting too much gold, as he has issues proxy farming in midlane. Remember that you can't use Satchel Charge as a dash while grounded!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with the Precision path, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Sion is never dying. Doran's Shield, Second Wind, and a Negatron Cloak on the first recall deletes you from the game. Just farm him for First Strike, and try clearing waves faster than him to roam.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Swain's power in lane is very dependant on how well he can hit his root, so as long as you manage to dodge it well, you should be set. Keep in mind not to stand too close to minions as Swain will be able to hit minions with his root to enlargen the hitbox.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Most of Sylas' damage is in his knock up, so avoiding it is key. To play around it effectively, I recommend surrounding yourself with minions, as it makes it more difficult for him to hit his knock up on you, even if being within melee range of Sylas isn't ideal. Though, once you bully a Sylas to low enough health, you should start maintaining your distance instead as his lunge heals him based on his missing health.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Your first few Levels are stronger than Syndra's so try to bully her with your Qs. Position yourself in a way so that you, Syndra, and one of her orbs don't form a straight line to not get stunned as easily.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Stay behind minions so Taliyah's stone barrages get blocked by them, while letting you poke her back. It's very important to not get bursted by Taliyah as your poke outclasses hers, so if she seems to set up a combo with her stone field to slow you, then knock you backwards, use your Satchel to dash out of the stone field first. You should also elect to play more defensively if she has access to both her knockback and stone field to avoid getting combo'd, and inversely, be more aggressive while they are on cooldown (14 seconds).

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Talon is pretty easy to bully Level 1 with basic attacks and Qs, but from Level 2 onwards you should pay more attention to his passive stacks from his W, and step back whenever it hits both ways. Whenever Talon uses his ult, drop a Satchel on top of yourself to prevent him from using his dash on you.

| [Midlane] [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health, and start Doran's Ring.] | Tristana is virtually unbeatable, as she is able to jump on you Level 1 and halve your health in one trade, and do that repeatedly. From Level 2 onwards, you should try your best to cancel her leaps with Satchel Charge. Stay away from your minions as one of her passives causes killed minions to deal damage around them.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health instead of 10-180 scaling health, and start Doran's Ring.] | While you theoretically hold the range advantage in the early game, you should still play somewhat defensively as his dash has a very long range, and you should bully him while it's on cooldown (12-8 seconds, reduced for each critical strike), but you can't really kill him due to his innate sustain, so just try farming gold off of him. You should play a lot more defensively once he hits Level 6, as his all-ins will near guarantee your death with Ghost while preventing his own with his Ultimate.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Twisted Fate is pretty easy to bully with abilities and empowered basic attacks, but avoid longer trades due to his stun and three-hit-passive making him edge out wins. Be careful of walking up in lane without vision as well, as Twisted Fate is very good at setting up ganks for his jungler. From Level 6 onward, stay aware of his ultimate if he's out of vision, as he could teleport behind you and cheese kills, or, if he teleports to a side lane, shove your wave and get as many plates as you can.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Stand behind minions, as his main ability only damages the first 2 targets it hits. Play aggressively, as Veigar doesn't have a lot of upfront damage and has very little self-peel in form of his cage, which has a massive 20 second cooldown, giving you very long windows to fight in. Note that your Satchel won't let you dash through the cage, so try to use it pre-emptively, or try to fight Veigar while in the cage.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Play around minions as often as you can, since Vel'Koz's main damaging ability gets blocked by minions. In case there's no nearby minions, it might be better to walk towards Vel'Koz, as it is harder to recast at closer distance. Remember to hold your Satchel so you can cancel Vel'Koz's ultimate beam's channel.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Vex is pretty easy to poke down, and her combo cooldowns are quite lengthy too, encouraging you to take extended trades if she misses anything. Don't get too close, as her self-shield deals damage surrounding her in a small area. Keep some distance while she has her abilities, especially if her passive bar is fully charged up, as Vex abilities are quite weak into long range and a stray fear can guarantee a lost trade for you.
| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | [Collecting matchup advice post buffs.]

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Avoid trading with Viktor in close quarters as his shield and auto enhancer are too strong for you to beat. Keep your distance to try and have a higher chance of avoiding his laser. Use your Satchel to dash out of his gravity field before getting stunned. Buying and upgrading boots after finishing Lost Chapter is encouraged.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | You realistically won't be able to kill Vladimir in lane, and he will heavily outscale you later, so just try to farm up gold off of him with First Strike, and avoid trades otherwise. Pay attention to the bar below his health, as it grants him movement speed toward enemy Champions when it turns red and empowers his next suck to do significantly more damage.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | Use your early game power to gain wave control, lane priority, and potentially bully Xerath. Hold your Qs for when Xerath is charging his own Q, as the self-slow makes it significantly easier to hit him with abilities. Also avoid having no minions between yourself and Xerath from Level 3 onward as his stun can be very dangerous at higher ranges. You should buy boots early to have an easier time dodging Xerath's skillshots.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health, and start Amplifying Tome.] | A Yasuo that starts lane with his dash is really difficult to deal with Level 1, as you can't really do anything about him dashing on top of you and starting a trade. Just try to accrue gold with First Strike and keep your distance from minions to avoid being dashed on. Use your Satchel to escape from a dash (either during dash, or after it), but be careful not to throw it into a wind wall which would doom your chances of escaping. Try clearing waves as fast as possible after purchasing Lost Chapter to prevent Yasuo from roaming!

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, with 65 flat health over 10-180 scaling health, and start Amplifying Tome.] | A Yasuo that starts his stab is much more manageable, as you can still poke him with basic attacks and farm comfortably Level 1 until you get enough experience to get Satchel Level 2. Apply the advice mentioned above.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Use your Q whenever Yone uses his stab, as it stops him in place for a short moment. His knock-up makes it especially easy to hit Qs, though you need to create more distance between yourself and Yone as it has a very long range. Use your Satchel to disengage from Yone when he enters his spirit form, as you will realistically never be able to win a trade against him in that form. Be mindful that his spirit form always returns him to where it was casted, so it's very easy to place a minefield or anticipatory ultimate when it runs out.

| [I would use the First Strike page in this lane, and start Amplifying Tome.] | Zed's shurikens do reduced damage if they hit something first, so standing behind minions is a really great way to reduce poke from him. You should ideally start fights with Zed when his shuriken or shadow double are on cooldown (6 and 20 seconds, respectively) as that's when he's at his weakest. Zed's ultimate also always places him behind you, making it easy-ish to disengage with a Satchel Charge.

| [I would use the Summon Aery page in this lane, and start Doran's Ring.] | The movements of a Zoe that's using Q become more predictable, giving you a great opportunity to counter-Q. Play far away from walls and stand behind minions to play around Zoe's bubble. Pay attention to her balloons before making trades. Remember that Zoe's ultimate always returns her to where she casted it from, making it easy to place minefields, satchel charges, and even ultimates on that spot.

| Alistar's kit is incredible for fights in the botlane with Ziggs, having so much crowd control that makes it trivial to hit even ultimates. The only problem is that Alistar's first few Levels are quite miserable, and roaming.
| Amumu has great set-up for a Ziggs with his bandage toss and ultimate combo being able to affect entire teams, letting you hit several people with your ultimate easily.

| Mage supports are pretty miserable to play with in the 2v2, as you have very little self-peel against more aggressive botlanes. Annie somewhat makes up for it with her Tibbers being great set-up for you to combo off.

| Marksmen supports are pretty miserable to play with in the 2v2, as you have very little self-peel against more aggressive botlanes, but Ashe somewhat makes up for it due to her entire poking and trading pattern being filled with slows, making hitting abilities with Ziggs very easy.
| While Bard has strong trading and great crowd controlling abilities for Ziggs to bounce off of, his roaming playstyle is very suboptimal for Ziggs, who loves the chaos of 2v2s in the botlane.
| Blitzcrank is downright one of the best supports you can pick with Ziggs, due to his great pick potential, strong crowd control and preventing escapes with his ultimate silencing enemy players.

| [Jungle] Brand jungle is weird to bounce off of, though his gank setups aren't the worst with a well aimed Satchel Charge to push your opponents towards him. Objective fights with mid/jungle 2v2s are pretty terrible though.
| [Support] Being a mage support with low range, terrible mobility, and bad self-peel makes laning with one awful as Ziggs.

| Braum is really good at protecting a Ziggs in 2v2s, and his passive isn't the worst, especially if you take the Summon Aery page with a bunch of attack speed. His ultimate is also really strong in teamfights, but ultimately isn't the best support you could pick with Ziggs.
| Camille's aggressive, short trade nature, is a match made in heaven with Ziggs, her ultimate locking down enemies making it easy to hit your own ultimate is great as well.
| Galio's knock-up + taunt combo is fantastic AoE crowd control for Ziggs' abilities, especially your ultimate. His ultimate is also a great engage and peel tool for you.

| Bel'Veth isn't the greatest jungler to have with Ziggs, but her knock-up is pretty good at facilitating your abilities. Otherwise, you're not really able to match her mobility and you can't support her much.
| Briar is much too aggressive for you to match her tempo, and her crowd control is a bit weak in conjunction with your abilities.
| While Cho'Gath is a nice frontliner and his knock up is certainly a strong set up tool for you kit, it's just too unreliable to be a great support.
| Diana is a great jungler to have, as her ultimate and your ultimate have great synergy together, and your mid/jungle 2v2 is okay.
| Ekko doesn't really have reliable crowd control or a good 2v2 with you midlane, but a lucky stun grenade can be great for you, and you're able to push enemies into it.
| Elise is only useful for you if she manages to hit her stun, and you're otherwise not bursty enough in the early game to have great kill angles without crowd control.
| Evelynn's charm is pretty strong for you to combo off of, and her innate execution effects are very nice in conjunction with your chip damage.

| Fiddlesticks has really good crowd control for you to bounce off of in the form of his fear, silence and ultimate, making ultimates really easy to hit in fights and such. Your early game mid/jungle 2v2 is pretty miserable though.
| Gragas has pretty strong crowd control to bounce off of for Ziggs, but you should be careful of a Gragas ultimate messing up your ultimates.
| Graves doesn't have any effective crowd control for you to synergise off of, nor do you have a great kit to facilitate him.
| Hecarim has fine crowd control, especially with his ultimate, but your mid/jungle 2v2 is pretty rough.
| Heimer being a mage support makes laning with him quite tough, but he's pretty strong against melee supports, letting him control the lane.
| Being a mage support with terrible mobility and rough self-peel is pretty rough with Ziggs against aggressive botlanes, even if, theoretically, the poke sounds fine.
| Ivern has solid crowd control and his shield is really useful for Ziggs, but your early game mid/jungle 2v2 is pretty rough and Ivern prefers champions that use basic attacks more.
| Janna as an enchanter doesn't do much for you, and she will most likely leave you to fend for yourself as she roams, but her peel makes her bearable to play with.
| Jarvan is fantastic, his ultimate being perfect for Ziggs' ultimate, as well as serving as a powerful frontliner and having great crowd control in the rest of his kit.
| Jax's stun is extremely powerful in conjunction with Ziggs' kit as an engage tool, and your early mid/jungle 2v2 is very formidable as well.
| Karma as a mage support isn't all that potent, though her basic abilities having enough crowd control to affect someone for short enough moments to get your Qs off makes it bearable.
| Karthus is pretty bad with Ziggs, only making up for it with his wall's magic resistance reduction and executioner-style ultimate synergising with Ziggs' chip damage.
| [Rhaast] | Rhaast's knock-up is great for teamfighting with Ziggs, but his mobility and not-so-frontliney playstyle is rough to handle, as well as Kayn's relatively weak early game.
| [Shadow Assassin] | Shadow Assassin provides nothing of use to Ziggs, and Ziggs provides nothing of use to Shadow Assassin, bar maybe additional damage off of your ultimate.
| Kha'Zix has nice ganks for Ziggs due to his burst damage, but not much else.
| Kindred has nice ganks for Ziggs due to her mark slowing enemy champions and her ult saving Ziggs from a pinch in a teamfight, but not much else.
| Lee Sin is a fine jungler, having a strong early game making the mid/jungle 2v2 alright and his kick being good peel or set-up for Ziggs' ultimate.

| Leona's crowd control, innate aggression, and passive empowering Ziggs' abilities, makes her one of the best supports you can pick for Ziggs as long as she remains in the lane for continued bloodbaths.
| Lillia's sleep is a really strong set up tool for your ultimate, but is otherwise pretty lackluster.
| Lulu as an enchanter does not have much synergy with Ziggs, but her polymorph and aggression make her bearable.
| Lux as a mage support with no mobility and poor peel makes her quite terrible to lane with as Ziggs.
| Maokai's crowd control makes him amazing with Ziggs, though you should be careful playing around Maokai's knockback, so as to not accidentally miss your abilities due to it.
| Master Yi has absolutely no crowd control in his kit, and his speed makes it hard for you to follow him, making him pretty anti-synergistic with you.
| Milio as an enchanter is pretty weak with Ziggs, but his passive enhancing your abilities and his football kick working as fine peel isn't the worst.
| Morgana as a mage-like support makes her pretty miserable to play with Ziggs, though her black shield and root makes it bearable.

| Nami as an enchanter immediately makes the lane somewhat rough, though Nami's kit has a lot of synergy with Ziggs such as empowering his abilities, and having fine enough peel and engage with her bubble and tsunami, making her one of the better enchanters to pick.
| Nautilus has fantastic crowd control with his entire kit, making him one of the best Ziggs enablers, especially with his ultimate and your ultimate synergising amazingly.
| While Neeko in lane is somewhat rough due to her relatively low amount of crowd control and mobility, her ultimate is amazing when coordinated with yours.
| Neither champion fulfils any needs of the other.
| Nocturne is somewhat awkward to play around, but his fear and ultimate work quite well with your kit.
| Nunu has great synergy with Ziggs due to his knock-up, root, as well as the slow on his ultimate, but it's simply not reliable enough.

| Ornn has really powerful crowd control with his dash and ultimate, being able to consistently hit your abilities during fights, and Ornn being able to upgrade your Rabadon's Deathcap is another nice bonus.
| Pantheon support loves aggression, and his stun with Press the Attack empowering your abilities is amazing, though he falters in larger scale skirmishes and teamfights.

| Poppy's short trades as a support are great and deal a lot of damage, while being able to defend you with her grounding ability. Her ultimate is also a great teamfighting tool, being able to knock up multiple people to set up your ultimate.

| Pyke has great engaging tools and crowd control, making your abilities easy to hit already, but his ultimate executing low-health enemies, something Ziggs struggles with, and giving you extra gold to snowball even further, makes him top tier, though a Pyke roaming elsewhere and leaving you to fend for yourself for minutes at a time is quite rough.
| Rammus has alright synergy with Ziggs due to his knock-up and taunt locking someone down for several seconds, but isn't consistent enough to make it a must-pick.
| Rek'Sai's knock-up is extremely reliable and very powerful with Ziggs, as well as serving as a powerful frontline.
| Rell has very consistent and powerful crowd control, making your abilities very easy to hit during laning phase, and her ultimate makes your own ultimate very easy to land during teamfights.
| Renata is strange to classify, but her crowd control simply isn't enough for you, and she has relatively weak peel in lane, with her stat buff being much more useful for marksmen, than a mage.
| Though Rengar does have a slow and root, they aren't really enough to justify being a 'synergistic pick' with Ziggs.
| Sejuani's consistent crowd control with her charge, stun and ultimate makes her an amazing jungler with you, especially during teamfights.

| Senna makes your laning unplayable against any semblance of aggression. Her peel is terrible, she doesn't support you much, and she has no mobility. You will simply get devoured in lane most of the time.

| All of Seraphine's basic abilities have little to no synergy for you. You have no shielding to empower her shielding effect, and your minefield is far too weak of a slow to empower her slow/root/stun. The only saving grace Seraphine has is her ultimate being insanely powerful.

| Sett has quite strong crowd control with his ultimate and pull, and him being encouraged to play very aggressively is favourable for you, but his low range is quite abusable and makes him rough to skirmish and teamfight with.
| Shaco as an assassin doesn't really synergise well with Ziggs, though your Satchel can technically throw them into his boxes, creating small crowd control chains, which is somewhat respectable.
| Shyvana doesn't really work well with Ziggs at all. Though her ultimate could technically synergise with your own, it's not enough.
| Skarner's entire kit has a bunch of crowd control, synergising with your kit in many ways, especially his ultimate together with yours.
|  Sona has terrible peel, weak early game and low mobility, making her a terrible pick with Ziggs, even if her ultimate is a respectable form of crowd control.
| Swain's weak peel, unreliable crowd control, and preferred fighting style being selfish longer trades, makes him a pretty bad pick with Ziggs.
| Soraka's unreliable crowd control and supporting style being entirely unfitting for Ziggs makes her a pretty weak support for him.
| As a jungler, Sylas doesn't really mesh too well with Ziggs, though his knock-up can be nice in some situations.
| Tahm Kench's all-ins can be really powerful with his crowd control, and his ultimate being able to save you from death entirely is great.
| Taliyah's slows make it really easy to hit your abilities when she's ganking you, and your Satchel works with Taliyah's stone field, letting you stun and damage enemies on Taliyah's behalf.
| Talon provides nothing special for Ziggs, and Ziggs doesn't do all that much for Talon either.
| Taric's stun is amazing with Ziggs, and his trading power empowering both himself and you makes him great.
| Thresh's hooks, crowd control, and being able to rescue you with lanterns makes him an amazing pick with Ziggs, even though his teamfight engages aren't as powerful as others.

| Trundle has mostly slowing effects with his chomp and ice pillar, which do make your abilities easier to hit, but him being a relatively poor frontliner, with weak peel and wanting extended fights makes him not ideal.
| Twitch provides no crowd control to the team, and his preferred style of play being consistent roaming and leaving you to fend for yourself 1v2 makes him terrible with Ziggs.
| Udyr's early game is not all that strong and his ganks aren't reliable enough with you to make him a good jungler for Ziggs.
| Vel'Koz's low mobility and horrendous peel makes him an atrocious pick with Ziggs into aggressive lanes, even though their poke sounds great in theory.
| Vi's charge is strong enough for Ziggs already, but her ultimate chaining with your own lets Ziggs really shine.
| Viego's stun is okay, but him preferring extended skirmishes and resets meshes somewhat poorly with Ziggs.
| Volibear has really strong ganks with Ziggs due to his stun chaining into his slow, letting you continue the chain with your own Satchel as well as landing other abilities.

| Warwick has many synergies with Ziggs, from his blood trails encouraging an executioner-esque playstyle, his fear being able to affect multiple champions for your AoE abilities, and his suppress making your ultimate extremely easy to land, in addition to serving as a strong frontline to protect you.
| Wukong's damage is respectable enough, and his ultimate is great crowd control during teamfights for your entire kit to shine, but his first 5 Levels aren't that synergistic with Ziggs.
| Xerath's low mobility and near-nonexistent peel makes him a painful pick with Ziggs against aggressive laners, even though their poke could be fantastic together.
| Xin Zhao's powerful early game and knock-up makes him a nice enough jungler to have, though he becomes hard to follow through with further into the game outside of your ultimate.

| Yuumi's only beneficial effect for Ziggs is her being able to restore your mana, but having no frontline to cover you, and no crowd control, with her kit favouring marksmen and fighters, makes her one of the worst picks you could play with Ziggs.

| Zac's crowd control is great, and you are able to chain crowd control in quick succession with both of your kits, from his knock-up, to your satchel charge, to his pull forming very effective lethal combos.
| Though Zilean's peel and ultimate can be pretty bad for Ziggs, his slows and stuns are amazing set up for your abilities.
| Zyra's low range, mobility and weak peel makes her horrendous with Ziggs.
| Though Zoe is quite immobile and her peel is weak, her aggressive nature makes her a strong enough support to dominate lanes with bursty combos.
